parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts. This parameter applies only to the multi-account evaluation pattern
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号ID。该参数仅适用于多账号检测模式
parameters.name: account_id

fields.help_en:
The filter condition key. Valid values:

ResourceId: the resource ID
ResourceName: the resource name
ResourceType: the resource type
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件键。取值：

ResourceId：资源ID。
ResourceName：资源名称。
ResourceType：资源类型
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The list of filter condition values
fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The ID of the evaluation snapshot
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the governance maturity evaluation. Valid values:

Account (default): Performs a single-account governance maturity evaluation and evaluates only the current account.
ResourceDirectory: Performs a multi-account governance maturity evaluation and evaluates all member accounts in the resource directory. Before performing this operation, upgrade to multi-account governance maturity evaluation
parameters.help_zh:
治理成熟度检测范围。取值：

Account（默认）：执行单账号治理成熟度检测，仅检测当前账号。
ResourceDirectory：执行多账号治理成熟度检测，即检测资源目录所有成员账号。操作前，需要先升级至多账号治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The specialized evaluation code. Valid values:

basic (default): foundation model (governance maturity) evaluation
ack: container building specialized evaluation
ai: machine learning specialized evaluation
nis: network service specialized evaluation
parameters.help_zh:
专项检测代码。取值：

basic（默认）：基础模型（治理成熟度）检测。
ack：容器构建专项检测。
ai：机器学习专项检测。
nis：网络服务专项检测
parameters.name: lens_code

parameters.help_en:
The evaluation domain. Valid values:

CloudGovernance (default): cloud governance maturity evaluation
AiGovernance: AI governance maturity evaluation
parameters.help_zh:
检测领域。取值：

CloudGovernance（默认）：云治理成熟度检测
AiGovernance: AI 治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: evaluation_domain
